messages:
Jin Park: Cutting RC candidate 2026.03.18-rc3 (sha: a1b2c3f). Requesting sign-off for the 10:00 UTC prod promotion window. Pinned: db migration flag OFF by default. Checklist: smoke, kv-warm, perf gate, release notes. @Samira @Ravi please ack.
Samira Patel: QA ack — smoke passed on staging (2 runs). One flaky embedding test logged as non-blocker in PR.
Ravi Shah: Ops ack. Reserved Dedicated capacity for 10:00 UTC. I'll hold rollback window until 10:20.
Grace L.: Docs updated: /docs/releases/rc3.md. Draft release notes: https://internal/release-notes/rc3 — small wording nit, otherwise good.
deploy-bot: Release candidate 2026.03.18-rc3 created by Jin Park. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/rc3. To promote run: `/deploy promote rc3 --env=prod --window=2026-03-18T10:00Z`
Jin Park: Running preflight now. Need smoke id and kv-warm confirmation. Samira, can you paste smoke run output?
Samira Patel: smoke id #4578. kv-warm OK. latency baseline +2ms. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: db-migration flag pinned off for promotion: `--db-migrate=false`. Canary plan: 10% for 5m, then 50% for 5m, then full.
Jin Park: Final sign-off requested. If no objections by 09:40 UTC we promote. Fallback model variant (small-quant) staged.
Ravi Shah: +1. Rollback plan ready: revert to tag `prod-stable` and run `./scripts/revert_db_flag.sh rc3` if needed.
Grace L.: +1 from docs side. Release notes updated with known streaming timeout limitation.
Samira Patel: QA final approve. Adding smoke logs: ```smoke: PASS
errors: 0
latency_p95: 112ms```
Jin Park: Kicking off deploy now. `/deploy promote rc3 --env=prod --window=2026-03-18T10:00Z --actor=Jin`
deploy-bot: Promotion started for rc3 -> prod at 2026-03-18T09:52:10Z. Canary 10% applied. Metrics (canary): error-rate +0.1%, latency +3ms. Proceeding to 50%.
Ravi Shah: Observability: seeing one pod OOM in eu-west-1, taking that instance out of rotation.
Jin Park: Abort further rollout, executing rollback. `/deploy rollback rc3 --to=prod-stable --reason="OOM eu-west-1"`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Restoring prod-stable from snapshot. Notifying oncall.
ops-bot: Pager sent to @SRE Oncall — incident labelled: rollback-rc3-oom.
SRE Oncall: Investigating. Preliminary: memory regression traced to new runtime kernel selection; replicating locally. Pinning back previous kernel and model variant.
Jin Park: Thanks — stopping promotions until kernel patch landed. Reopening RC branch for hotfix. Will update this thread with postmortem and next promo window.
